name: Deploy WP plugins & themes to Hostinger (dry-run by default)

on:
  push:
    branches: [staging]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      live:
        description: 'Set to "true" to perform real deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'false'

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    env:
      HOST: ${{ secrets.HOSTINGER_HOST }}
      USER: ${{ secrets.HOSTINGER_USER }}
      PLUGINS_PATH: ${{ secrets.TARGET_PLUGINS_PATH }}
      THEMES_PATH: ${{ secrets.TARGET_THEMES_PATH }}
      KEY_B64: ${{ secrets.HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY_B64 }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install deps
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y rsync openssh-client coreutils

      - name: Validate secrets present
        run: |
          if [ -z "$KEY_B64" ]; then echo "ERROR: HOSTINGER_SSH_KEY_B64 missing"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$HOST" ]; then echo "ERROR: HOSTINGER_HOST missing"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$USER" ]; then echo "ERROR: HOSTINGER_USER missing"; exit 1; fi
          echo "Secrets look present (values masked)."

      - name: Write key and load ssh-agent
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          printf '%s' "$KEY_B64" | base64 --decode > ~/.ssh/id_rsa
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_rsa
          eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"
          ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa
          ssh-keyscan -H "$HOST" >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts || true

      - name: Ensure remote dirs
        run: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "$USER@$HOST" "mkdir -p '$PLUGINS_PATH' '$THEMES_PATH'"

      - name: Rsync plugins
        run: |
          DRY_FLAG="--dry-run"
          if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.live }}" = "true" ]; then DRY_FLAG=""; fi
          rsync -avz --delete $DRY_FLAG --exclude='.git' --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='wp-config.php' --exclude='wp-content/uploads' ./wp-content/plugins/ "$USER@$HOST:$PLUGINS_PATH/"

      - name: Rsync themes
        run: |
          DRY_FLAG="--dry-run"
          if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.live }}" = "true" ]; then DRY_FLAG=""; fi
          rsync -avz --delete $DRY_FLAG --exclude='.git' --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='wp-config.php' --exclude='wp-content/uploads' ./wp-content/themes/ "$USER@$HOST:$THEMES_PATH/"

      - name: Post-deploy (permissions) -- only on live
        if: ${{ github.event.inputs.live == 'true' }}
        run: |
          ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "$USER@$HOST" "chown -R u689060721:u689060721 '$PLUGINS_PATH' '$THEMES_PATH' || true; if command -v wp >/dev/null 2>&1; then wp cache flush --path=/home/u689060721/domains/lightsteelblue-dolphin-977863.hostingersite.com/public_html --allow-root || true; fi"

      - name: Finish
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.live }}" = "true" ]; then echo "LIVE deploy finished"; else echo "DRY-RUN finished"; fi
